facts.text: Sister Bay is a village in Door County, Wisconsin, situated along the shore of Green Bay on the Door Peninsula.
The Sister Bay Historical Society preserves and promotes the local history to honor the past and build a better future.
The historic Koessl Barn hosts programs featuring the families and businesses that contributed to the unique character of Sister Bay.
Sister Bay is restoring the Bunda Boathouse to create a Waterfront Museum showcasing the area's important maritime history.
The Waterfront Museum will house artifacts like the Shadow, a pristine 1929 Chris Craft runabout with a storied history in Sister Bay.
Local history programs in Sister Bay have explored topics ranging from the cottage industry era of tourism to early postcard history.
